LanguageData.JJ_UseArrowDesc: Use a Stand Arrow in this pawn's inventory or up to one tile away. Risk of serious injury or death on failure. The Arrow is consumed.
LanguageData.JJ_NoArrow: Need a Stand Arrow in inventory or on an adjacent tile.
LanguageData.JJ_SummonDesc: Manifest or recall {0}. The intangible Stand cannot be targeted as a separate pawn.
LanguageData.JJ_PunchDesc: Choose a nearby target for the Stand's short-range blunt attack.
LanguageData.JJ_PunchInvalid: Invalid target, out of range, blocked line of sight or ability on cooldown.
